title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Previews Episode 11
content: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA previewed Episode 11 on Tuesday. The episode is titled “That was fun,” and will premiere on August 27, at 11:00 PM JST. Crunchyroll and Muse Asia are streaming the series. Episode 11 synopsis: If we stay close, it’s truly warm. If we hadn’t separated, it should have been fine.
author: Anime Corner

title: Every Major Exciting One Piece Project Coming in 2027
content: One Piece is by far one of the biggest franchises in the entertainment industry, and despite the manga series reaching its conclusion and clearly being only a few years away from ending, the franchise continues to grow.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime Has Created the Perfect New Action Hero in Just Eight Episodes
content: The Summer 2026 season is packed with diverse anime; however, it wouldn’t feel complete without a shonen anime, and this is exactly what Crunchyroll is providing with Black Torch . Since the start of the season, Black Torch has emerged as the perfect shonen anime, embracing familiar tropes that have defined the genre.
author: ComicBook

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Game's Trailer Announces English Voice Cast
content: Konami revealed the English voice cast for Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, a new game in its Castlevania series, in a trailer on Monday. • Abby Trott as Rose Belmont • J.B. Blanc as Trevor Belmont • Alejandra Reynoso as Sypha Belnades (reprising role from Castlevania animated series) • Graham McTavish as Dracula…
author: ANN

title: One Piece’s Most Powerful Elbaph Characters Get New Looks From Legendary Creator
content: The Elbaph Arc in One Piece is by far the most intense and crucial phase of the story almost three decades after its debut. The story has long since entered its Final Saga, which is all the more reason that the Straw Hat Pirates are closer to Laughtale than ever.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece May Have Just Lost Its Chance to Fix Its Biggest Fan Complaint
content: One Piece manga is seeing things get very exciting in the Elbaph arc as the series’ supposed final villain, Imu, the King of the World, continues his dominance in the fight, which has also presented an opportunity to incorporate one of the series’ most missing elements that is becoming necessary now.
author: ComicBook

title: Marvelous Teases New Story of Seasons, Rune Factory 6 Games
content: Marvelous teased its next title in the Story of Seasons game franchise with footage on Monday, along with the first footage of Rune Factory 6 during the "Story of Seasons 30th Anniversary and Rune Factory 20th Anniversary" livestream.
author: ANN

title: RetroCrush Adds Guyver OVA, Live-Action Dororo Film
content: RetroCrush announced on August 1 it will add the live-action Dororo film with Japanese audio and the English dubbed version of The Guyver: Bio-Booster Armor , the OVA adaptation of Yoshiki Takaya 's Bio-Booster Armor Guyver manga , on August 21. Both titles are available to stream now.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Might Retcon Its Finale’s Most Divisive Scene With Time Travel Twist
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War made a massive change to the anime’s final arc with the latest episode of the series, and it might be on the verge of fixing a major issue that fans had with the original manga with a new time travel twist.
author: ComicBook

title: K Manga Adds Daiki Yamazaki's Golden Phantom Manga
content: The company describes the series: While on an outing to an amusement park with his family to celebrate his daughter's middle school graduation, Shingo Asahina encounters a mysterious man covered in blood being pursued by some unsavory characters.
author: ANN
